blocks.text: PV cells ka markazi usool photovoltaic effect hai: roshni parne par kisi madde mein voltage aur electric current ka paida hona. Is asar mein photons ki energy se semiconductors mein electrons valence band se conduction band mein excite hote hain. Yeh amal PN junction se behtar hota hai, jo electrons aur holes ko alag kar ke aisa voltage banata hai jo electric current chalata hai.

blocks.caption: Photovoltaic effect ke qadam
rows: roshni ke photons semiconductor se takrate hain
electrons valence band se conduction band mein excite hote hain
PN junction electrons aur holes ko alag karta hai
alag hua charge voltage banata hai jo current chalata hai

blocks.prompt: Solar cell mein semiconductor ke ek block ke bajaye PN junction kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Roshni akeli electrons ko conduction band mein excite karti hai, magar yaksan block mein woh bas wapas gir kar holes se mil jate. Junction ka andaroni field electrons ko ek taraf aur holes ko doosri taraf dhakelta hai, to charges alag hote hain aur cell par qabil-e-istemal voltage aur current zahir hota hai.

items: Photovoltaic effect: photons semiconductor ke electrons ko valence band se conduction band mein excite karte hain; PN junction electrons aur holes alag karta hai, voltage aur current deta hua.
